## File: facebookresearch_mlgym/data/titanic/evaluate.py

Prompts

```
['run the evaluate function to compare a submission CSV against ground truth and print accuracy metrics', 'test the load_data function to load ground truth and submission CSV files into pandas DataFrames', 'test the validate_submission function to check that a submission has the correct columns and row count', 'test the calculate_metrics function to compute accuracy score between ground truth and predicted survival values', 'refactor the evaluate function to support additional metrics beyond accuracy for the Titanic dataset']
```

